summary: Hyundai ABS Funding LLC filed an 8-K reporting the entry into material definitive agreements for a securitization transaction. The filing details the issuance of Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B notes backed by auto loan receivables. The documents include a receivables purchase agreement, trust agreement, sale and servicing agreement, indenture, administration agreement, and asset representations review agreement. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is disclosed; this is a routine structured finance current report.
